newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up $1-2, more paper than wet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up $1-2, more paper than wet.

text.p: NWE naphtha gained $1-2 a tonne on Tuesday amid quiet business. Dealers said the gains reflected a consolidation in screen crude which has been bolstered by gasoline.
Physical activity was slow and paper was barely better, traders said.

Swaps were understood to have traded around $176.50 and $177.50 for July, but there was little talk on August or September. August was pegged at a $2 contango to July while September was a further $1 contangoed.
